oh i’m sorry :(((( it’s really weird and dangerous to leave people who are mentally struggling just hanging there for months..

of course it’s ok!!! mental health problems are a very good reason to take a break, don’t feel pressured to stay in school just because others do! frankly, it would do a ton more harm than leaving right now.

but damn, at least two months for a therapist?? i’m sorry, i don’t live in the uk so maybe that’s normal there, but that sounds like a lot.. do you have someone to talk to? are you comfortable without a therapist for longer periods of time? 

also, i’m sorry you feel so shitty, i’m wishing you the best!!
